content: react-hook-form useFieldArray({ control, name }) returns { fields, append, remove, move } for dynamic repeatable rows (itinerary days, inclusion/exclusion/bring items). Register nested fields with template-literal names like itinerary..title (bracket notation not supported since v7). fields[].id is an autogenerated key for React's key prop, not the row's real id. append/remove/insert require full default-value objects, not partial.
